title: Agent Overflow theme
description: A theme file states one or two per-mode palettes as sparse overrides of the built-in palette of that polarity. The theme id is the filename stem; there is no "extends" key, because the variant name IS the base.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor completion.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the filename stem.

variant.description: One mode palette. Every section is optional and every section is sparse; a token you do not name keeps the built-in value.

colors.description: colors — app chrome (UI axis). Sparse: name only the tokens you are changing.

surface-0.description: App ground: the window and page background every pane sits on.

surface-1.description: First elevation step: cards, inputs and panels lifted off the ground.

surface-2.description: Second elevation step: chrome sitting on a card (menus, chips, hover fills).

surface-3.description: Third elevation step: progress tracks and hover fills on chrome already at tier 2.

border-strong.description: Prominent hairline: turn dividers and hover-emphasized control borders.

border-subtle.description: Softest hairline, for ambient chrome. Follows the border color. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

text-secondary.description: Supporting text: secondary labels, quoted prose, muted glyphs.

fg-muted.description: Body copy. Follows the focal text color at reduced strength. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

fg-subtle.description: Labels and de-emphasized text. Follows the focal text color. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

fg-hint.description: Timestamps and barely-there hints. Follows the focal text color. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

accent.description: Primary accent: selection, links, focus rings and filled buttons.

accent-fg.description: Foreground painted on an accent fill, so a pale accent cannot strand its own label.

md-heading.description: Markdown headings in chat prose (the code-axis counterpart is syntax-markup-heading). Follows the focal text color. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

md-bold.description: Markdown bold text in chat prose. No code-axis counterpart exists, so curated themes pick an emphasis hue of their own. Follows the focal text color. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

md-link.description: Markdown links in chat prose (the code-axis counterpart is syntax-markup-link). Follows the accent. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

md-blockquote.description: Markdown block-quote text in chat prose (the code-axis counterpart is syntax-markup-quote). Follows the supporting text color. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

md-marker.description: Markdown list bullets and numbers in chat prose (the code-axis counterpart is syntax-markup-list). Follows the muted body-text tier (fg-muted). Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

info.description: Informational status: input prompts and neutral notices.

success.description: Success status: completed work, added lines, healthy state.

error.description: Failure status: errors, removed lines, refusals.

warning.description: Attention status: a human is blocked (approvals, pending input).

provider-codex.description: Codex provider identity. Brand-locked by default.

provider-claude.description: Claude provider identity. Brand-locked by default, with no separate light value.

provider-claude-tui.description: claude-tui provider identity: the phosphor green of a CRT terminal.

overlay.description: Backdrop dimming app chrome behind a modal or sheet. Varies with the mode.

scrim.description: Chrome painted over USER MEDIA (lightbox grounds, thumbnail badges). Stored opaque and consumed at partial alpha; mode-invariant by default.

scrim-fg.description: Foreground of the media-overlay pair. Stored opaque and consumed at partial alpha; mode-invariant by default.

design-paper.description: The design canvas iframe paper. Sandboxed agent HTML is authored against a light page, so this is default-locked.

card.description: Ambient card ground, referenced at low alpha by tool rows and cards. Follows the first elevation tier. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

ico-terminal.description: Tool-kind icon: shell and terminal commands.

ico-file.description: Tool-kind icon: file edits and writes.

ico-search.description: Tool-kind icon: search and pattern matching.

ico-globe.description: Tool-kind icon: network and web fetches.

ico-robot.description: Tool-kind icon: subagents and delegated work.

ico-speech-bubble.description: Tool-kind icon: conversation and messaging tools.

ico-checklist.description: Tool-kind icon: task lists and plans.

ico-puzzle.description: Tool-kind icon: MCP servers and plugin tools.

ico-clock.description: Tool-kind icon: waits, sleeps and scheduled work.

ico-compaction.description: Tool-kind icon: context compaction. A muted slate that reads as a system operation.

ico-generic.description: Tool-kind icon fallback for unclassified tools. Follows the secondary text color. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

syntax.description: syntax — highlight families (code axis). Sparse: name only the tokens you are changing.

syntax-string-special.description: Escapes, interpolation markers and regex literals.

syntax-function.description: Function and method names at definition and call sites.

syntax-variable-builtin.description: Built-in variables such as this, self and super.

syntax-constant.description: Constants and enum members, including the language booleans.

syntax-label.description: Labels, goto targets and named arguments.

syntax-markup-raw.description: Markdown inline code and fenced blocks.

syntax-added.description: Added lines in an embedded diff.

syntax-removed.description: Removed lines in an embedded diff.

ansi.description: ansi — ANSI 16 foregrounds (code axis). Sparse: name only the tokens you are changing.

ansi-fg-30.description: ANSI 30 (black) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-31.description: ANSI 31 (red) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-32.description: ANSI 32 (green) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-33.description: ANSI 33 (yellow) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-34.description: ANSI 34 (blue) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-35.description: ANSI 35 (magenta) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-36.description: ANSI 36 (cyan) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-37.description: ANSI 37 (white) foreground. Follows the app text palette unless overridden. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

ansi-fg-90.description: ANSI 90 (bright black, i.e. grey) foreground. Follows the app text palette unless overridden. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

ansi-fg-91.description: ANSI 91 (bright red) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-92.description: ANSI 92 (bright green) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-93.description: ANSI 93 (bright yellow) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-94.description: ANSI 94 (bright blue) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-95.description: ANSI 95 (bright magenta) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-96.description: ANSI 96 (bright cyan) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

ansi-fg-97.description: ANSI 97 (bright white) foreground, in chat output and the terminal alike.

code.description: code — code-surface grounds (code axis). Sparse: name only the tokens you are changing.

code-block.description: Ground behind a fenced code block. Follows the first elevation tier, so a code theme can move blocks without moving every card with them. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.

md-inline-code.description: Markdown inline-code text, painted on the code-inline-bg chip (the highlight counterpart is syntax-markup-raw). Lives on the code axis BECAUSE its ground does — a UI-axis text color over a code-axis ground could pair unreadably. Follows the focal text color. Derived by default — override only to stop it tracking.
